**Response 2:** Charcoal/black backgrounds with sparse bright accents (teal/gold); subtle scroll animations, calm hovers, purposeful transitions — Intentional restraint, accessibility, minimal distraction.

**UNIFYING TEXTURE:** Self-aware pattern-matching to design principles with uncertainty about authenticity.
